run_genarris_jobs: run Genarris crystal structure generation jobs for molecules from a CSV file via SLURM
create_genarris_jobs: create Genarris structure generation jobs for molecules with different Z values and space groups
create_gnrs_config: create a Genarris ui.conf configuration file for a specific molecule, space group, and Z-value
create_gnrs_submit_script: create a SLURM submission script for executing Genarris crystal structure generation with MPI
get_genarris_config: extract and validate the Genarris configuration section from the main workflow config dictionary
